name: Bessie
description: A serpentine lake-monster cryptid reported in Lake Erie since the late 18th century, most often described as a 9–12 m grey snake-like creature. Reports cluster along the south shore of the lake, earning the nickname 'South Bay Bessie'.
origin: Reports come from across Lake Erie, with the densest cluster on the southern shore in Ohio (Sandusky Bay, Kelleys Island, Put-in-Bay, the Lake Erie Islands) and the Ontario shore near Fort Erie.
